summary: Character-type (ctype) retrieval for a wide character string, with a one-time CRT mode auto-detection. On first call, probes GetStringTypeW against the test string String2 and falls back to GetStringTypeA against String1, caching the chosen mode (1=Unicode, 2=ANSI) in the global dword_8D41D0. Unicode mode forwards straight to GetStringTypeW. ANSI mode measures the wide string via WideCharToMultiByte, converts it into an alloca'd buffer, then calls GetStringTypeA with the locale (falling back to dword_8D3F38) and a two-word sentinel window to detect the converted length, copying the result into the caller's lpCharType via sub_58B130. Stack buffers are guarded with __alloca_probe inside an SEH frame. Called by sub_58F939 (0058f939).

local_names.dwInfoType: character-type information flag set passed to GetStringTypeW/A
local_names.lpSrcStr: wide source string whose character types are requested
local_names.cchSrc: length of lpSrcStr in wide characters
local_names.lpCharType: caller buffer receiving the character-type words
local_names.CodePage: code page for WideCharToMultiByte; defaults to global CodePage (0x008D3F48)
local_names.Locale: locale for GetStringTypeA; defaults to global dword_8D3F38
local_names.v8/v9/v18: required multibyte length returned by the measuring WideCharToMultiByte call
local_names.v16: stack buffer used as the ANSI conversion and character-type workspace
local_names.lpMultiByteStr: ANSI form of the source string produced by WideCharToMultiByte
local_names.v15: sentinel window at the end of the character-type buffer
local_names.StringTypeA: BOOL result of the GetStringTypeA conversion call

operations.description: Mode cache dword_8D41D0 is read; when zero the CRT mode has not been detected and auto-detection runs, otherwise the cached v6 is reused
Mode-detection probe: GetStringTypeW(1, &String2, 1, &CharType) tests the Unicode API against the static test string String2; success selects mode 1
Mode-detection fallback: GetStringTypeA(0, 1, String1, 1, &CharType) tests the ANSI API against the static test string String1; failure returns 0, success selects mode 2
Detected mode (1 or 2) is cached back into the global dword_8D41D0 for subsequent calls
Unicode path: when cached mode v6==1, returns GetStringTypeW(dwInfoType, lpSrcStr, cchSrc, lpCharType) directly
ANSI path: a zero CodePage argument defaults to the global code page (0x008D3F48) before the conversion
Measuring call: WideCharToMultiByte(CodePage, 0x220, lpSrcStr, cchSrc, 0, 0, 0, 0) computes the required multibyte length v8 (cached as v9 and v18)
Measurement result v8 must be non-zero to proceed with the ANSI conversion and its stack allocations

SEH frame entered for the stack work: the exception registration (TryLevel, old_esp) is set up against the TEB-relative SEH data (byte_FF00000000001692/1695/1699/169B) and the ScriptFrameProcessor handler (0x0058895C), with the stru_5B9AF0 frame region; the frame is released by setting TryLevel back to -1 after the conversions
First stack allocation: v8+3 rounded up to a multiple of 4 is reserved with alloca, probed by __alloca_probe
The multibyte workspace v16 is zero-filled for v9 bytes by sub_58BB10
Conversion call: WideCharToMultiByte(CodePage, 0x220, lpSrcStr, cchSrc, lpMultiByteStr, v9, 0, 0) fills the workspace with the ANSI form; its BOOL result gates the rest of the ANSI path
Second stack allocation: 2*v9+5 rounded up to a multiple of 4 is reserved with alloca (probed by __alloca_probe) for the WORD character-type buffer v16
A zero Locale argument defaults to the global locale dword_8D3F38 (stored into v14)
Sentinel setup: the two WORDs at v16[cchSrc-1] and v16[cchSrc] are preset to -1 (0xFFFF) to mark the end of the converted character-type output
ANSI conversion call: GetStringTypeA(v14, dwInfoType, lpMultiByteStr, v18, v16) produces the character-type words into v16; the BOOL result is captured as StringTypeA
Sentinel check: the conversion is accepted only when v16[cchSrc-1] is no longer 0xFFFF and v16[cchSrc] is still 0xFFFF, i.e. the converter wrote exactly cchSrc words
sub_58B130 copies 2*cchSrc bytes of the converted character-type words from v16 into the caller's lpCharType buffer; on success the function returns StringTypeA

Returns 0 on the ANSI-detection failure, the conversion failure, the sentinel mismatch, or the code page measurement failure paths; returns StringTypeA on the successful ANSI path and the GetStringTypeW result on the Unicode path
Invoked by sub_58F939 (0058f939), the packet-listed caller of this CRT helper

clean_pseudocode: if (v6 == 1) return GetStringTypeW(dwInfoType, lpSrcStr, cchSrc, lpCharType);
StringTypeA = GetStringTypeA(Locale, dwInfoType, v16, v18, v16);
unresolved: dword_8D41D0 is a process-global mode cache shared across callers; its lifecycle and reset points are outside this packet
The sentinel-window idiom (v16[cchSrc-1]/v16[cchSrc]) is characteristic of an MSVCRT GetStringTypeA helper but its exact upstream contract is not evidenced here
TEB-relative globals byte_FF00000000001692/1695/1699/169B are compiler-generated SEH bookkeeping, not application state
GetStringTypeW/GetStringTypeA/WideCharToMultiByte appear as import thunk globals; the packet does not name their import module
